instrument_command.description: Verify the telecommand acceptance path and reporting in the HS telemetry

Unconditionally transitions to the instrument to the SAFE state
Prepare the instrument for a safe shutdown by transitioning the instrument to the SAFE state

This command resets the telemetry/telecommand interface (including clearing the Tx/Rx FIFOs) to the power-up status, allowing for a re-determination of the active command side. Transmission of the next telemetry packet will commence once the SpW interface reset completes.
